{{Quote|Is it him? Are we sure it's him?|[[Akris Ur'etu]] questions the Trandoshan on their attacker's identity|<ref name="Rep" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Color/Legends|bronze]]-scaled '''Trandoshan thug''' worked as part of the criminal organization known as the [[Skar'kla Consortium]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], serving the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Akris Ur'etu]]. During the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan's]] time serving Akris, a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] rival of the Consortium, who had been trying to move in on their territory, hired an [[Unidentified Hutt enforcer|enforcer]] to harass the criminal organization and [[Death/Legends|kill]] its leader.

The enforcer, disguised as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to divert suspicion from the Hutts, tracked down Akris and attacked him, despite the fact that the crime lord had hired the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to kill the false Jedi. The Trandoshan and five other thugs who accompanied Akris at the time of the attack escaped with him into a Skar'kla base and sealed its [[Blast door/Legends|blast doors]] behind them. The Trandoshan was one of the thugs closest to the door and was ordered by Akris to check if the Jedi was still chasing them. Before the thug could, however, the Jedi impersonator began cutting through the blast doors with a stolen blue [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Trandoshan and other thugs fired with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] at where they thought the attacker would be once the door broke open, but hit nothing. Once they ceased fire to find their target, the enforcer rolled a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] through the ruined door, which exploded, completely obliterating the Trandoshan and two other thugs.

The enforcer went on to kill all of the remaining thugs with his lightsaber and eventually Akris as well, whom he choked to death with a gas emitter designed to make it look like the enforcer was [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force choke|Force-choking]] the Bothan.<ref name="Rep" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshan thug first appeared in the short story ''[[Reputation (Cad Bane)|Reputation]]'' written by [[Ari Marmell]] and illustrated by [[Tom Hodges|Thomas Hodges]] which was published in ''[[Star Wars Insider 136]]'' in [[2012]].
